The package follows standard AUR packaging practices and does not exhibit any signs of supply chain compromise. While the checksums are pinned (not 'SKIP'), the sources are immutable release assets from a trusted upstream (Adoptium), which is a secure configuration. The use of symbolic links for shared resources like `cacerts` is a well-established method to avoid duplication and maintain system-wide trust stores.
</details>

All operations are confined to system configuration tasks directly related to the JDK's integration into the host environment.

There is no obfuscation, suspicious command usage, or data exfiltration. The script uses only safe, predictable shell constructs and system utilities.
